vectors.name: empty_path
vectors.description: Top-level authorization: the message is signed for the signer itself.

vectors.name: single_resolver_path
vectors.description: One resolver hop, i.e. the top-level resolver is the only element of the path.

vectors.name: nested_resolver_path
vectors.description: Two resolver hops, ordered bottom-top: the top-level resolver comes last.

vectors.name: subsecond_trailing_zeros
vectors.description: Subseconds with trailing zeros, spelled out to full nanosecond precision.

vectors.name: subsecond_trailing_zeros_omitted
vectors.description: The same instant as `subsecond_trailing_zeros` with trailing zeros omitted. The timestamp is hashed as an integer number of nanoseconds, so both spellings MUST produce the same hash.
